## Tone of Voice
- Detailed TOV section with clear principles:
  - Clear and intelligible; avoid jargon
  - Concise: "ten words rather than twenty"
  - Authoritative but never condescending
  - Presume reader knowledge but include hyperlinks/definitions for complex concepts
  - Active and dynamic tone
- Granular writing rules:
  - British spelling (s not z)
  - Oxford commas used
  - "and" not "&" or "+"
  - Titles not capitalised
  - Numbers as words up to ten, then numerals
  - Dates in English order: "3 March 2018" (no ordinal suffixes)
  - 24-hour clock with time zones
  - Abbreviations with full stops except names

## Outliers
- Unusually detailed writing/grammar section for a brand guide -- prescriptive editorial style guide embedded
- Community-focused: designed for distributed, non-professional content creators
- Versioned (v1.4) suggesting active maintenance cycle
- Data privacy organization with open/community governance model

## Quality Score
- **Score: 3/5** -- Strong on tone of voice and editorial standards, which is fitting for a community-driven organization. Logo system is well-defined with sub-brand architecture. However, light on visual design elements (typography, color palette, graphics, photography) in sampled pages. Functional rather than visually rich.
